title: Mention
description: User mention record tracking when a user is mentioned in content, with context and timestamp. Used for social media platforms, notification systems, and @mention functionality.

id.description: Unique identifier for the mention record

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who was mentioned

mentioned_in.description: ID of the content item where the mention occurred (post, comment, etc.)

context.description: Text context or excerpt where the mention appears

created_at.description: Timestamp when the mention was created
